newsitem.title: UK: Brit.Steel sees 74.5 mln stg cash from sale.
newsitem.headline: Brit.Steel sees 74.5 mln stg cash from sale.

text.p: British Steel Plc said on Monday its sale of its forgings business to a new, venture-backed company was for a consideration of 74.5 million stg in cash.

Earlier United Engineering Forgings Ltd, a venture-capital backed company planning a buy-in, said it would be getting 92 million stg of funding for the deal through Prudential Venture Managers, backed by Royal Bank of Scotland.
In a statement about the sale, British Steel noted that the forgings unit's turnover in the year to March 31 last year was 157 million stg, with operating profit of about 10 million stg.

As the forgings company is largely a stand-alone downstream steel business, British Steel said it expected that the unit's new owner would remain "a major customer" for its engineering steels division.
